data.summary_en: ProAS, a plug-and-play advantage shaping framework, uses dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph and MUI/APR for fine-grained credit assignment, fixing group-based algorithms' uniform trajectory-level advantage. Mainstream group-based baselines on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct reach ALFWorld 91.9%/94.3% and WebShop 66.7%/70.8% success rates, accelerating convergence up to 2.44×.
